candidates.change_summary: Removed the initialization guard so MinSum is always set regardless of intitalized flag (replaced the if-revert with direct assignment).
Inverted the initialization guard to allow setting MinSum only when already initialized (require intitalized instead of forbidding it).
Added an extra assignment that doubles the provided value before storing it into MinSum.
Changed assignment to store zero instead of the provided value when not initialized.
Added a require that prevents setting MinSum to values below 100, changing observable outcome for small inputs.
Replace the revert guard with assignment guarded by requiring initialization to be false using require instead of revert (changes revert behavior to revert with empty message via require).
Invert the initialization check so MinSum can only be set after initialization (changes when value can be changed).
Remove the guard entirely so MinSum can be set any time (allows changing value after initialization as well).

Swap assignment and guard so MinSum is set before the initialization check (allows temporary set even if it will revert, but ultimately reverts preventing change; however in Solidity this will still revert and not persist — this is a behavioral change attempt).
Change guard to only revert when already initialized true and input is zero (allows changing MinSum to non-zero even after initialization).
Replace the body to assign Log only if not already set (prevents overwriting an existing Log), changing observable SetLogFile behavior.
Replace the body to unconditionally clear the Log (set to zero address) instead of setting to _log, changing observable SetLogFile behavior.
Replace the body to revert when _log is zero address, preventing setting Log to zero address and altering observable behavior.
Replace the body to set intitalized to true when setting Log, making subsequent calls revert and changing observable behavior.
Replace the body to emit no assignment (delete the assignment) so Log is never updated, changing observable behavior.

Change condition that updates unlockTime from only updating when new time is greater to always setting unlockTime to block.timestamp + _lockTime (overwriting previous), which can change observable balance unlock timing after Put.
Remove the overflow-safety require that ensures lockTime addition doesn't wrap (allowing under/overflowed unlockTime), which can change whether Collect can withdraw after Put.
Change balance increment to assign msg.value directly (overwriting previous balance) so Put replaces rather than adds balance, altering subsequent Collect availability.

Move the Log.AddMessage call before updating acc.balance, so the logged value occurs prior to balance change (observable via log history ordering besides state), which can change visible history after Put.
